versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g If the <ComUser_CbkRxTOut> notification call- back is configured in the Com High Proxy (via the ComUserCallbackName (See [ECUC_Com_10036]), where the respective ComUserCallbackType (See [ECUC_- Com_10034]) is set to COM_RX_TOUT ) the configured <ComUser_CbkRxTOut> call- back shall be invoked when the associated SwCluC_ComProxy_CbkRxTOut instance of the Com Low Proxy is called.
